draft.emotion: inspired and awestruck, looking up at a massive peak
notes: Notice how 'góra' means both a mountain and the top or upper part of something (e.g., 'na górze' – at the top / upstairs, 'do góry' – upwards). In the plural, 'góry' often refers to a mountain range (e.g., 'jechać w góry' – to go to the mountains).
